privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: APIPoints ('we', 'our', or 'us') operates the apipoints.dev website and the APIPoints intelligence API. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, disclose, and safeguard your information when you use our services.
privacy.section1Content: We collect information you provide directly: account registration details (name, email, password), API usage data, billing information processed through Stripe, and communication preferences.
privacy.section2Content: We use collected information to: provide and maintain our services, process transactions, send service-related communications, improve our API and intelligence endpoints, and comply with legal obligations.
privacy.section3Content: Your data is stored on Cloudflare's infrastructure with D1 database. Passwords are hashed using PBKDF2 with per-user salts. API keys are stored as SHA-256 hashes. We implement industry-standard security measures.
privacy.section4Content: We use Stripe for payment processing, Cloudflare for hosting and infrastructure, and analytics services to improve our platform. These services have access to information required for their functions.
privacy.section5Content: We retain your account data for as long as your account is active. API usage logs are retained for 90 days. You may request data deletion by contacting support.
privacy.section6Content: You have the right to access, correct, delete, or port your personal data. Contact us at support@apipoints.dev to exercise these rights.
privacy.section7Content: We use essential cookies for authentication and session management. We do not use third-party advertising cookies.
privacy.section8Content: We may update this policy from time to time. Material changes will be notified via email or website banner.
privacy.section9Content: Questions about this Privacy Policy? Contact us at support@apipoints.dev.

terms.section1Content: APIPoints provides real-time LLM pricing, model benchmarks, and deprecation alerts through REST API endpoints and MCP-native integrations.

terms.section3Content: Free accounts receive 5,000 credits on signup. Paid subscriptions provide additional credits monthly. Credits do not roll over. Unused credits expire at the end of each billing cycle.
